examPolicy: A section is a JavaScript volume, a C chapter group, or a selected TCP/IP chapter range. Endpoints are inclusive. TCP/IP Chapter 16 includes only 16.1 and 16.3. Quizzes cover assigned material; exams mix their chapter banks and extra questions where provided. 80% passes. Pending ranges and canceled placeholders have no assessment.
